_comment: Curated descriptions for the solve.js CLI subcommands. Consumed by scripts/gen-solve-commands-index.js (run via `npm run steering:generate`) to emit docs/steering/generated/solve-commands.md. Keys MUST match the COMMANDS map in scripts/solve.js: a registered command missing here renders as `(undocumented)` and a key here that is not registered renders under `Documented but not registered`, so `npm run steering:check` fails on either drift. Add or correct entries here, not in the generated markdown.

start.summary: Seal a quest: validate solve/quests/<id>/quest.json and its epic, measure the doneWhen probe, refuse unless the probe is red, then record sealedAt (HEAD) and the seal-time metric in the log.

note.summary: Append a finding, one hypothesis/change/measurement attempt, a content-bound independent verification, a package assignment/amendment with an existing authority reference, a resumable blocked hold, or terminal exhausted/superseded outcome. Assignment and untyped observations preserve holds; attempts and typed findings clear the current projection hold.
note.usage: node scripts/solve.js note --id <quest> (--finding "<text>" [--kind <kind>] [--status <status>] [--evidence <ref>] | --attempt "<what changed>" | --assignment "<reason>" --paths-file <list> --authority "<existing authorization>" | --verification "<summary>" --verifier subagent:<id> --verdict approve|reject | --blocked "<why>" --next-owner judgment|verification|authorization | --exhausted "<why>" | --superseded "<why>" [--by <quest>]) [--json]

probe.summary: Measure a quest's doneWhen (or an epic's with --epic): metric, target, done, whether it measured, the delta from the seal-time value, and the last three log entries.

land.summary: Land a sealed Quest after its probe, current package assignment and applicable epic scope, independent content-bound review for source/proof/acceptance changes, altitude and interaction guards, static checks and staged change proof pass. Collects all changed paths; isolate unrelated work. Required generated outputs must fit the assignment. Commits and records solved; never pushes.

evidence.summary: Add uploads and verifies by re-download/hash before recording evidence; --replace requires deliberate replacement authority. Delete requires the exact --authorize-asset value. Relocate preserves source provenance, verifies custody and records into an open Quest; --dry-run previews. Evidence upload writes a typed finding that clears a current blocked hold; retain unresolved holds explicitly.

board.summary: Print the open epics and open quests computed from solve/epics and solve/quests on demand; nothing is written.
